scope: Strategy-only account-aware Void timing context. This file interprets supplied account observations but never selects a route, boat, helmet, purchase, or Pest Control outcome.

observation_conventions.point_balance: Use observed resources.pest_control_commendation_points when present; otherwise use the current Pest Control currency balance. Missing values are unknown, not zero.
observation_conventions.owned_pieces: Regular top, robe, gloves and helmet item counts plus items.elite_void_top and items.elite_void_robe are explicit ownership observations. An Elite piece satisfies its corresponding set slot, but the analyzer never upgrades or equips anything.
observation_conventions.diary: diary_tiers['Western Provinces'] records only the highest confirmed claimed tier; it never proves the remaining tasks, upgrade, or any item ownership.

strategic_preferences.veteran_wait: Waiting to start an otherwise planned Void grind until Veteran is available can be a points-rate preference. It is not an equipment requirement and lower boats remain factual regular-Void paths.
strategic_preferences.elite_alignment: Aligning a player-declared Elite Void objective with the hard diary and the top-and-robe upgrade budget is a timing consideration, not an instruction to delay or buy regular Void.

stop_conditions: The player-declared objective changes or the required observed pieces are already owned or upgraded.
The observed point balance, team or world availability, attention, supplies, or player readiness changes.
A recorded Pest Control session ends, is interrupted, or becomes unavailable.
reentry_conditions: The same declared objective remains useful and the hard purchase or upgrade gates are still met.
A current observed point balance and current Pest Control availability/session snapshot are supplied when the player wants them considered.
A Veteran preference may be reconsidered after the account reaches combat 100; it never invalidates lower-boat access.
